title: Wire budget checkpoints into daemon pauses
summary: Budget checkpoint records exist, but daemon runtime pause and operator-requested shutdown paths need to save and claim checkpoints so resume semantics survive real daemon control flow.
expectedFailureModes: Daemon pause writes budget events without creating a resumable checkpoint.
Resume can claim the same checkpoint more than once across daemon restarts.
Operator shutdown skips checkpoint persistence and loses pause state.
nextAction: Continue hard runtime preemption separately; current daemon checkpoint wiring covers budget exhaustion, single-use resume claim, and shutdown drain paths.
